description: Add a native editor layer. Use text, image, shape, group and qr layers for static designs. SVG uses an image layer with isSvg:true. Position is the layer CENTER in canvas pixels. The layer accepts the same persisted fields as /editor: transforms, opacity, blendMode, text styles/effects/rich text, image filters/customFilters/crop/masks/local effects/perspective, shape gradients/strokes/shadows, QR styling and persisted editor fields. Returns the changed slide as an inline preview automatically. Does not create or render video.

layer.description: Native layer object. At minimum provide type and its content field.

name: picorn_editor_add_layer
title: Picorn Editor: add layer
